{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module TokenAuth where

import Data.Word (Word32, Word64)
import Data.Int (Int64)
import Data.Bits (shiftR, (.&.))
import qualified Data.ByteString as BS
import qualified Data.ByteString.Char8 as BSC
import Data.IORef
import qualified Crypto.Hash as H
import qualified Data.ByteArray as BA
import Data.Time.Clock.POSIX (getPOSIXTime)

-- | Token format: [4 bytes userId] [4 bytes issuedAt] [4 bytes ttlSeconds] [32 bytes hmac]
-- Total: 44 bytes

data TokenClaims = TokenClaims
  { claimUserId   :: !Word32
  , claimIssuedAt :: !Word32
  , claimTTL      :: !Word32
  } deriving (Show, Eq)

data AuthResult = Authorized Word32 | Denied String
  deriving (Show)

-- | Server secret key (in production, loaded from secure storage)
serverSecret :: BS.ByteString
serverSecret = "k8x#mP2$vL9nQ4wR7jF1hT6yB3cA0dE5"

-- | Compute HMAC-SHA256 for token integrity
computeHMAC :: BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString
computeHMAC key msg = BS.pack $ BA.unpack digest
  where
    ipad = BS.map (`xor'` 0x36) paddedKey
    opad = BS.map (`xor'` 0x5c) paddedKey
    paddedKey = BS.take 64 (key `BS.append` BS.replicate 64 0)
    innerHash = H.hash (ipad `BS.append` msg) :: H.Digest H.SHA256
    digest = H.hash (opad `BS.append` BS.pack (BA.unpack innerHash)) :: H.Digest H.SHA256
    xor' a b = a `xor` b
      where xor = \x y -> fromIntegral ((fromIntegral x :: Word32) `Data.Bits.xor` (fromIntegral y :: Word32))

-- | Serialize claims to bytes for HMAC computation
serializeClaims :: TokenClaims -> BS.ByteString
serializeClaims tc = BS.pack
  [ w32Byte 3 (claimUserId tc), w32Byte 2 (claimUserId tc)
  , w32Byte 1 (claimUserId tc), w32Byte 0 (claimUserId tc)
  , w32Byte 3 (claimIssuedAt tc), w32Byte 2 (claimIssuedAt tc)
  , w32Byte 1 (claimIssuedAt tc), w32Byte 0 (claimIssuedAt tc)
  , w32Byte 3 (claimTTL tc), w32Byte 2 (claimTTL tc)
  , w32Byte 1 (claimTTL tc), w32Byte 0 (claimTTL tc)
  ]
  where w32Byte n w = fromIntegral (shiftR w (n * 8) .&. 0xFF)

-- | Parse raw token bytes into claims + signature
parseToken :: BS.ByteString -> Maybe (TokenClaims, BS.ByteString)
parseToken bs
  | BS.length bs /= 44 = Nothing
  | otherwise = Just (claims, sig)
  where
    claims = TokenClaims
      { claimUserId   = readW32 0
      , claimIssuedAt = readW32 4
      , claimTTL      = readW32 8
      }
    sig = BS.drop 12 bs
    readW32 off = fromIntegral (BS.index bs off) `shiftL` 24
              .|. fromIntegral (BS.index bs (off+1)) `shiftL` 16
              .|. fromIntegral (BS.index bs (off+2)) `shiftL` 8
              .|. fromIntegral (BS.index bs (off+3))
    shiftL = Data.Bits.shiftL
    (.|.) = (Data.Bits..|.)

-- | Check if token has expired
-- Uses Int64 to avoid overflow issues with Word32 arithmetic
checkExpiry :: TokenClaims -> Word32 -> Int64
checkExpiry claims nowEpoch =
  let expiresAt = fromIntegral (claimIssuedAt claims) + fromIntegral (claimTTL claims) :: Int64
      now64 = fromIntegral nowEpoch :: Int64
      -- Positive means still valid, negative means expired
      remaining = expiresAt - now64
  in remaining

-- | Constant-time comparison to prevent timing attacks
constantTimeEq :: BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString -> Bool
constantTimeEq a b
  | BS.length a /= BS.length b = False
  | otherwise = (== 0) $ BS.foldl' (.|.) 0 $ BS.zipWith xor a b
  where
    xor x y = x `Data.Bits.xor` y
    (.|.) = (Data.Bits..|.)

-- | Main authentication function
authenticateToken :: BS.ByteString -> Word32 -> AuthResult
authenticateToken rawToken currentTime =
  case parseToken rawToken of
    Nothing -> Denied "malformed token"
    Just (claims, providedSig) ->
      let expectedSig = computeHMAC serverSecret (serializeClaims claims)
          sigValid = constantTimeEq providedSig expectedSig
          timeRemaining = checkExpiry claims currentTime
      in if not sigValid
         then Denied "invalid signature"
         -- Token is valid if remaining time is non-negative
         else if timeRemaining >= 0
              then Authorized (claimUserId claims)
              else Denied "token expired"

-- | Issue a new token
issueToken :: Word32 -> Word32 -> Word32 -> BS.ByteString
issueToken userId issuedAt ttl =
  let claims = TokenClaims userId issuedAt ttl
      payload = serializeClaims claims
      sig = computeHMAC serverSecret payload
  in payload `BS.append` sig

-- | Rate limiting state
data RateLimiter = RateLimiter
  { rlWindow    :: !Int
  , rlMaxReqs   :: !Int
  , rlCounter   :: !(IORef Int)
  , rlLastReset :: !(IORef Word32)
  }

newRateLimiter :: Int -> Int -> IO RateLimiter
newRateLimiter window maxReqs = do
  counter <- newIORef 0
  lastReset <- newIORef 0
  return $ RateLimiter window maxReqs counter lastReset

checkRateLimit :: RateLimiter -> Word32 -> IO Bool
checkRateLimit rl now = do
  lastR <- readIORef (rlLastReset rl)
  if now - lastR > fromIntegral (rlWindow rl)
    then do
      writeIORef (rlCounter rl) 1
      writeIORef (rlLastReset rl) now
      return True
    else do
      count <- readIORef (rlCounter rl)
      if count >= rlMaxReqs rl
        then return False
        else do
          writeIORef (rlCounter rl) (count + 1)
          return True

-- | Full request handler combining auth + rate limiting
handleRequest :: RateLimiter -> BS.ByteString -> IO (Either String String)
handleRequest rl token = do
  now <- fmap (fromIntegral . (round :: Double -> Word64) . realToFrac) getPOSIXTime
  let currentTime = fromIntegral (now .&. 0xFFFFFFFF) :: Word32
  allowed <- checkRateLimit rl currentTime
  if not allowed
    then return $ Left "rate limited"
    else case authenticateToken token currentTime of
      Denied reason -> return $ Left reason
      Authorized uid -> return $ Right $ "authenticated user " ++ show uid
